candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit acceptance condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit (allowing deposits equal to MinDeposit).
Invert the deposit condition so deposits are only accepted when msg.value <= MinDeposit (accepting small deposits instead of large ones).
Remove the conditional check entirely by replacing the if-statement with its body (always accept deposits).
Change the safe-add require to an assertion that the incoming value is nonzero (removing overflow check), using require(msg.value > 0).
Remove the require overflow check line (allowing potential overflow behavior to affect balances).
Replace the balances update to set balances[msg.sender] = msg.value (overwrite previous balance instead of adding).
Change the logging call to record a different value: log zero instead of the actual msg.value (affects observable History but not balances — excluded because target is balances, so omitted).
